overloads.semanticRole: The VERIFY CURRENT DATA FILE command carries out a structural check of the objects found in the data file currently opened by 4D.

constraints: Identical behavior to VERIFY DATA FILE but applied to the currently open database's own data file, so it takes no structurePath/dataPath.
If called with no parameters at all, defaults are: objects = Verify All (16), options = 0 (log file created, not timestamped), method = "", tablesArray/fieldsArray omitted.
Flushes the data cache and blocks all operations accessing the data for the duration of the verification.
If a log file is generated, its complete pathname is returned in the Document system variable.
See VERIFY DATA FILE for the full meaning of objects, options, method, tablesArray and fieldsArray.
